name: llm-dark-patterns
description: A 10-hook suite that suppresses LLM dark-pattern defaults at the textual boundary. Catches false-success closeouts, training-cutoff confusion, unsolicited paternalism, sycophancy, permission-loops, vibe time estimates, fake recall, fake stats, fake citations, and context loss after auto-compaction. Out-of-band bash judges, model-can't-rewrite. Backed by AbstentionBench, Anthropic's Constitution, AAAI 2026 sycophancy research, and the CoT-faithfulness literature.
